doe_central_composite — MULTIVAR plan op

• 資料種類:無 → design(僅由參數決定的運算子 —— 不接受影像或資料輸入)

• 呼叫: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.doe_central_composite(factors=3, alpha='rotatable', center=4, generators=None, inscribed=False) -> 'dict'(要直接呼叫實作,import doe; doe.doe_central_composite(factors=3, alpha='rotatable', center=4, generators=None, inscribed=False) -> 'dict';從台帳取用則 opsmultivar.get("doe_central_composite"))

• GPU:無(僅 CPU 參考實作)

用法

中心複合設計（Box 與 Wilson 1951）-> design。

> 以下的詳細說明為原文 —— 摘要與標題已翻譯。

Three parts: the two-level factorial (full 2^k, or a fraction from generators as in doe_fractional_factorial — it must be resolution V or better so that every two-factor interaction of the quadratic model stays estimable), 2k axial points at ±alpha on each axis, and center centre points.

alpha: "rotatable" — alpha = F^(1/4) with F the number of factorial points (the prediction variance then depends only on the distance from the centre; Box & Hunter 1957), "face" — alpha = 1 (face-centred, three levels only), "spherical" — alpha = sqrt(k), or a number > 0.

inscribed=True shrinks the whole design by 1/alpha so that the axial points sit at the ends of the range (lo/hi) and the factorial points inside it; otherwise the factorial points sit at lo/hi and the axial points go outside the range — meta['outside_range'] then names the factors whose natural values leave lo..hi (check that the bench can be set there).
